cues.zh: 这是深圳一个工作日的夜晚。
cues.en: It's a weekday night in Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 中国的好公民们来到这个公园，为了更健康、更快乐、更有生产力。
cues.en: The good citizens of the PRC have come to this park to get fitter, happier and more productive.

cues.zh: 这一切都在邓小平——中国自由市场改革备受尊崇的鼻祖——赞许的目光注视下进行。
cues.en: All under the watchful, approving gaze of Deng Xiaoping, the revered granddaddy of China's free market reforms.

cues.zh: 这一幕足以让你了解深圳的许多面貌。
cues.en: The scene tells you much of what you need to know about Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 这当然是中国。但也有所不同。
cues.en: It's China for sure. But it's also something different.

cues.zh: 这是一座移民之城：年轻、勤奋、聪明、思想往往更自由的人们，从全国各地汇聚而来。
cues.en: It's a city of imports: young, hardworking, smart, and often freer-thinking people, plucked from all around the country.

cues.zh: 他们来这里白天辛勤工作，晚上提升自我，为了出人头地。
cues.en: They've come here to toil during the day, improve themselves at night, and to get ahead.

cues.zh: 雄心壮志是深圳的生命线。
cues.en: It's ambition that is the lifeblood of Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 它的工厂；它的市场；它的初创企业；它蓬勃发展的科技帝国。
cues.en: Its factories; its markets; its startups; its surging tech empires.

cues.zh: 还有这样的场景：LED灯狂欢般的绽放，这是更环保、当然也更未来版的烟花。
cues.en: And it's stuff like this: an orgiastic explosion of LEDs that are the greener, and of course more futuristic, version of fireworks.

cues.zh: 你所在的城市能做到吗？
cues.en: Can your city do that?

cues.zh: 不能。你所在的城市绝对他妈做不到。
cues.en: No. Your city sure as shit can't.

cues.zh: 但接下来要讲的，是深圳为什么能做到。
cues.en: But here's the story of why Shenzhen can.

cues.zh: 以及为什么所有人——尤其是硅谷那帮人——都该意识到，并且大概该有点害怕，即将降临到他们头上的事。
cues.en: And why everyone - especially the folks in Silicon Valley - should be aware, and probably a little frightened, of what's coming for them.

cues.zh: 你走进那个金属管子里。以荒唐的速度直冲115层，到平安大厦的顶端。
cues.en: You get in the metal tube. Zoom up 115 floors at a ridiculous speed to the top of the Ping An skyscraper.

cues.zh: 然后找一扇窗，惊叹于深圳那壮阔的巨大。
cues.en: Then you find a window, and marvel at the sublime bigness of Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 四十年前，这里全是农田和土路，只是香港边境对面一个不起眼的农村货物交易小枢纽。
cues.en: Forty years ago all this was farmland and dirt roads, a minor hub for rural goods trading just across the border from Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 如今，它是闷热、潮湿、疯狂躁动的家园，住着1300万人
cues.en: Now, it's the hot, steamy, frenetic home to 13 million people

cues.zh: 地球上几乎所有人都称它为中国硅谷。
cues.en: that just about everyone on Earth calls the Silicon Valley of China.

cues.zh: 这里一切都以所谓的深圳速度运转。
cues.en: Everything here moves at what's known as Shenzhen Speed.

cues.zh: 这句话形容变化速度势不可挡，我来这儿就是想亲身感受一下。
cues.en: It's a phrase that describes an unyielding pace of change, and I came here to feel it firsthand.

cues.zh: 为此，先在城市景观前摆个Instagram姿势，快速扫一眼有没有政府的间谍无人机，
cues.en: To do that, it's an Instagram pose with the cityscape, a quick scan for government spy drones,

cues.zh: 然后乘车去看看我们用的几乎所有东西是在哪儿制造的。
cues.en: and then a car ride, to see where just about everything we use gets made.

cues.zh: 你总听说中国的工厂。今天我运气不错，能实地参观一家
cues.en: You hear about factories in China all the time. Today I'm lucky enough to actually go visit one

cues.zh: 位于市中心外大约一小时车程的工厂。
cues.en: that's located about an hour outside of the center of the city.

cues.zh: 他们会让我们看看这些工厂内部的生活是什么样的。
cues.en: They're gonna let us see what life is like inside one of these factories.

cues.zh: 有阴森的工厂，有还过得去的工厂，然后是这个地方，由Grandsun Electronic经营。
cues.en: There are grim factories. There are decent factories. And then there's this place, run by Grandsun Electronic.

cues.zh: 可以肯定地说，这跟我预想的不一样。
cues.en: It's safe to say this is not what I expected.

cues.zh: 豪华的环境是为了让来自世界各地的客户感到舒适。
cues.en: The plush surroundings are intended to make customers from all parts of the world feel comfortable.

cues.zh: 但里面更符合你的预期：几十名工人以“深圳速度”忙碌着，
cues.en: But inside it's more like you'd expect: dozens of workers moving at Shenzhen Speed,

cues.zh: 为一家名为 Nura 的澳大利亚公司生产高端耳机。
cues.en: making fancy headphones for an Australian company called Nura.

cues.zh: 你们是怎么来到深圳的？我想现在大家都这么做吧。
cues.en: How did you guys end up in Shenzhen? I guess that's the thing to do these days.

cues.zh: 是的。深圳以“大家来造东西的地方”而闻名。
cues.en: Yeah. Shenzhen is known as a place that people come to to make things.

cues.zh: 你来这里不是为了瞎混，而是为了把事情办成。
cues.en: You don't come here to mess around, you come here to get things done.

cues.zh: 这里有成熟的供应链——有能制造耳机所需任何零部件的供应商。
cues.en: They have the supply chain here - a supplier that can make any component of the headphones you need.

cues.zh: 当然还有劳动力成本，虽然不如以前便宜，但依然很合理。
cues.en: And of course there's the labor cost, which is not as cheap as it used to be but still reasonable.

cues.zh: 从开工以来，生产线基本上一直在满负荷运转。正常情况下我们一天能做500个。
cues.en: The production line has been running at basically maximum capacity since we started. And yeah we can do 500 a day normally.

cues.zh: 我们背景里听到的那些轻微噪音是什么？
cues.en: What are the little noises we hear in the background?

cues.zh: 你听到的声音，是他们在确认扬声器有没有装好。
cues.en: You're hearing them make sure they assembled the speaker correctly.

cues.zh: 所以那是测试的声音？
cues.en: So that's like a test noise?

cues.zh: 对，没错。
cues.en: Yeah that's right.

cues.zh: 但制造这些精美玩具的人，生活又是怎样的呢？
cues.en: But what is life like for the people who make these wonderful toys?

cues.zh: 为了体验一下工厂生活，我也加入了疯狂的午餐大军。
cues.en: To get a taste of the factory experience, I join the mad dash for lunch.

cues.zh: 嗯，大食堂的饭菜。
cues.en: Mmm, cafeteria food.

cues.zh: 伙食怎么样？
cues.en: How's the food?

cues.zh: 你在这里工作多久了？
cues.en: How long have you worked here?

cues.zh: 关于中国工厂工人的生活，其实很难说出什么新鲜事。
cues.en: It's tough to say anything terribly new about the life of the Chinese factory worker.

cues.zh: 他们大多数来自内陆地区，通常把家人留在了农村老家。
cues.en: Most of these people have come from China's hinterlands, often leaving their families behind in their rural hometowns.

cues.zh: 他们平均会在深圳待上两年左右，
cues.en: They'll spend about two years on average in Shenzhen,

cues.zh: 拼命加班，只为尽可能多存些钱。
cues.en: busting their butts working overtime to save up as much money as they can.

cues.zh: 这比面朝黄土背朝天的自给农耕生活更好吗？也许吧。
cues.en: Is it a step up from hardscrabble subsistence farming? Probably.

cues.zh: 还有安全网吗？有的。
cues.en: Are there still safety nets? Yep.

cues.zh: 但我可以告诉你，比起我们这些老外，中国人有一个很大的生活方式优势。
cues.en: But I can tell you one major lifestyle advantage the Chinese have over us gweilos.

cues.zh: 我们刚开始在这里工作时，午饭后基本谁都叫不动。
cues.en: When we first started working here, after lunch we couldn't really get anyone's attention.

cues.zh: 后来我们才明白，那个点大家都在睡觉。
cues.en: Eventually we cottoned on, everyone's just sleeping at that time of day.

cues.zh: 话虽如此，我们很快就欣然接受了。
cues.en: That said we embraced it very quickly.

cues.zh: 你更喜欢用什么睡觉装备？
cues.en: What is your preferred sleeping apparatus?

cues.zh: 我比较将就，要么趴在桌上，要么钻到桌下，拿点气泡膜当枕头。
cues.en: I'm pretty Spartan, so either on the desk or under the desk with a bit of bubble wrap for a pillow.

cues.zh: 相信我，挺舒服的。
cues.en: Trust me, it's good.

cues.zh: Luke只是众多来深圳做产品的创业者之一。
cues.en: Luke is just one of many entrepreneurs who come to get their gear made in Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 这里的硬件创业氛围很活跃，适合那些想快速行动、把东西做出来的团队。
cues.en: There's a flourishing scene here for hardware startups that want to move fast and make things.

cues.zh: 很多人聚集在这里，一家叫Hax的创业孵化器。
cues.en: Many of them can be found here, at a startup incubator called Hax.

cues.zh: 这里的思路很简单：帮初创公司做出原型，
cues.en: The idea here is simple: help startups build a prototype,

cues.zh: 再把它们对接给工厂，让工厂能开始成千上万地量产它们的产品。
cues.en: then connect them with factories that can start cranking out their products by the thousands.

cues.zh: 来看看 Jamie，他是英国初创公司 Carv 的一员，是个很随和的人。
cues.en: Take Jamie, here an affable chap who's part of a British startup called Carv.

cues.zh: 我们做的是数字滑雪教练。相当于你把一个插片放进滑雪靴里，它就能教你如何滑得更好。
cues.en: We make a digital ski coach. So effectively it's like an insert you put into your ski boot and it teaches you how to ski better.

cues.zh: 你可以通过耳机获得实时反馈，比如刚才那转弯不好，那个转弯不好，这个转弯好一些。
cues.en: So you get like real time feedback through headphones, like, that was a bad turn, that was a bad turn, that was a better turn.

cues.zh: 你这里就有一个，对吧？
cues.en: You have one here, don't you?

cues.zh: 对对，我给你看看。
cues.en: Yeah yeah, let me show you.

cues.zh: 这些是运动传感器，具备完整的运动感知能力。
cues.en: So yeah, these are motion sensors that have full motion sensing.

cues.zh: 太厉害了。
cues.en: Crazy.

cues.zh: 和这里的许多初创公司一样，Carv 最初也只是个不起眼的 Kickstarter 众筹项目。
cues.en: Like many startups here, Carv began life as a humble Kickstarter campaign.

cues.zh: 仅仅几年之后，他们每月就能生产出 5000 台产品。
cues.en: Now, just a couple of years later, they're pumping out 5000 units of their product every month.

cues.zh: 你觉得如果当初你被英国的孵化器录取，能在英国把这样的东西做出来吗？
cues.en: Do you think you could have brought something like this to life in the UK if you had been accepted by an incubator there?

cues.zh: 还是说你来到这里之后，见识到了一个全新的世界？
cues.en: Or now that you've been here you've seen a new world I guess?

cues.zh: 我觉得这多少取决于你手头有多紧。
cues.en: I think it kind of depends a little bit on how much of a shoestring you're on.

cues.zh: 在深圳便宜多了，各种方面都便宜，
cues.en: Here in Shenzhen it's so much cheaper - in many different categories it's cheaper,

cues.zh: 比如产品开发阶段，打印或加工各种材料。
cues.en: like in the product development phase to get different materials 3D printed or machined.

cues.zh: 在这里，成本大概只有一半，速度却快一倍。有时候甚至快七倍。
cues.en: You get it here for kind of half the cost and twice as fast. And sometimes seven times as fast.

cues.zh: 为了感受这里的高速活力，我和 Jamie 穿过街道，来到大名鼎鼎的华强北市场。
cues.en: To get a feel for that high speed energy, I hop across the street with Jamie to the famed Huaqiangbei markets.

cues.zh: 对。这大概是世界上最大的电子市场。
cues.en: Yeah. So this is the biggest electronics market in the world, probably.

cues.zh: 对这里的年轻创业者来说，这是一项重要的资源，
cues.en: They're an important resource for the young entrepreneurs here,

cues.zh: 也是一个让你感官超载的绝佳地方。
cues.en: and a fantastic place to get your senses overloaded.

cues.zh: 这里就像个热闹的蜂巢！
cues.en: Such as a hive of activity in here!

cues.zh: 天哪，太棒了，这就是那种能量，对吧。你走进市场，就像，砰！你懂吧，就像，好吧。
cues.en: Aw man it's great, so this is the energy right. You just walk through the market and it's like, bang! You know like, OK.

cues.zh: 这里是工厂向潜在买家展示产品的地方，
cues.en: This is where factories have come to display their wares to potential buyers,

cues.zh: 买家就是我，还有这里的很多人。有点像工厂的店面。
cues.en: who is me and a lot of the other people here. Kind of a storefront for factories.

cues.zh: 好。那如果我做智能手机、电视之类的，是不是来这儿看最新最牛的东西？
cues.en: OK. And if I make smartphones or TVs or anything like that, I kind of come here to see the latest and greatest stuff?

cues.zh: 没错。你想找制造商，就来华强北。
cues.en: Exactly. You want to find a manufacturer, you come to Huaqiangbei.

cues.zh: 这也是给你的原型找缺失零件的好地方，
cues.en: It's also a great place to find that missing part for your prototype,

cues.zh: 所以你会碰到 Hax 的其他团队在过道里逛。
cues.en: which is why you run into other crews from Hax roaming the aisles.

cues.zh: 买螺丝吗？
cues.en: Buying some screws?

cues.zh: 买弹簧。你试过——出去左转就有一家弹簧店，专做弹簧的女店主，要的话可以去看看。
cues.en: Buying some springs. Have you tried - there's a spring woman front if you want one. Just on the left as you go out.

cues.zh: 一小时内就能拿到零件，这简直太惊人了。
cues.en: The fact that I can get a component in, like, an hour is like absolutely phenomenal.

cues.zh: 这就是——这就是深圳速度。这就是我们在这里的原因。
cues.en: That's like - that is Shenzhen Speed. That's why we're here.

cues.zh: 深圳是这样运作的。
cues.en: Here's how Shenzhen works.

cues.zh: 你先盖一座"哎呀，这儿发展得真不错"的摩天大楼。
cues.en: You put up a, "damn, things are going well here" skyscraper.

cues.zh: 然后在旁边再盖一座——因为你能盖。
cues.en: Then you put up another one right next to it - because you can.

cues.zh: 接着，为了把这点彻底坐实，你还在旁边建起一座冶金奇迹般的体育场。
cues.en: And then, to really drive the point home, you do all of this next to a metallurgic marvel of a stadium.

cues.zh: 我们说的是一座举世未见的新兴繁荣之城。
cues.en: We're talking about a boomtown the likes of which the world has never seen before.

cues.zh: 而这一切才刚刚开始。因为大体育场里才是真正的重头戏。
cues.en: And things are just getting started. Because inside the big stadium is the real action.

cues.zh: 那里是智慧、创造力和拼搏精神汇聚一堂、集体注入的现场。
cues.en: It's a scene of smarts creativity and hustle being collectively mainlined.

cues.zh: 看起来不怎么样，闻起来也不怎么样，甚至可能有点不人道。
cues.en: It doesn't look pretty. It doesn't smell great. It might even be inhumane.

cues.zh: 但这一切都是为了把中国打造成未来科技领域的主导力量。
cues.en: But all of this is aimed at making China the dominant technology force of the future.

cues.zh: 硅谷应该感到非常非常恐惧。
cues.en: And Silicon Valley should be very very afraid.

cues.zh: 朋友们，欢迎来到RoboMasters。
cues.en: Welcome, friends, to RoboMasters.

cues.zh: 这是一场机器人竞赛，吸引了来自世界各地的数百名工程专业学生。
cues.en: This is a robotics competition that draws in hundreds of engineering students from around the world.

cues.zh: 你很快就会看到，我其实不太懂这个游戏的复杂之处。
cues.en: As you'll soon see I don't really understand the intricacies of the game.

cues.zh: 但大致玩法就是你要造机器人，可以从六种类型里选。
cues.en: But the gist is that you build some robots, choosing from six different types.

cues.zh: 比如工程师，能治疗其他机器人；还有英雄，能造成额外伤害。
cues.en: Like the Engineer, which heals other bots, or the Hero, which does extra damage.

cues.zh: 然后你把它们放进竞技场，让它们互相发射塑料子弹来得分。
cues.en: Then you put them in a stadium and have them fire plastic bullets at each other to score points.

cues.zh: 全家都能乐在其中……前提是你家人都是一群极度好胜的技术狂。
cues.en: It's fun for the whole family... if your family is a bunch of insanely competitive gearheads

cues.zh: 它们在射击，小心，它们在射击。
cues.en: They're shooting, be careful, they're shooting.

cues.zh: 糟了，枪口正对着我。
cues.en: Oh shoot, it's got the gun on me.

cues.zh: 对参赛选手来说，这可能是一段紧张刺激的经历。
cues.en: For contestants, this can be an intense experience.

cues.zh: 你上周的生活过得怎么样？
cues.en: What's your life been like for the last week?

cues.zh: 平均每天只睡三四个小时。
cues.en: The average sleeping time is like three or four hours.

cues.zh: 你怎么做到每天都这样，还能坚持好几周？太疯狂了。
cues.en: How do you do it every day and keep doing that for weeks? It's crazy.

cues.zh: 喝红牛。
cues.en: Drinking Red Bull.

cues.zh: 这些年轻人一到比赛现场，基本上两周都不会离开体育馆。
cues.en: Once these kids arrive for the competition, they basically don't leave the stadium for two weeks.

cues.zh: 一场接一场地参加机器人格斗比赛，身体也吃不消。
cues.en: And fighting robot battle after robot battle takes its toll.

cues.zh: 你上次吃东西是什么时候？
cues.en: When was the last time you had something to eat?

cues.zh: 昨天。
cues.en: Yesterday.

cues.zh: 所以你今天还没吃东西？
cues.en: So you haven't eaten today?

cues.zh: 没有。
cues.en: No.

cues.zh: 不过这一切都值得，因为如果你够幸运，最终的奖励就是获得 DJI 的工作机会，
cues.en: But it's all worth it, because the reward, if you're lucky, is a job at DJI,

cues.zh: DJI 是这场比赛的赞助商，也是全球顶尖的无人机制造商。
cues.en: the sponsors of the competition and the world's top maker of drones.

cues.zh: 如果你是有才华的年轻机器人专家，来深圳的 DJI 工作就是梦想。所以这场比赛的赌注很高。
cues.en: If you're a talented young roboticist, coming here to Shenzhen to work at DJI is the dream. So the stakes are high.

cues.zh: 你好吗？你们快赢了吗？
cues.en: How are you doing? Are you guys winning?

cues.zh: 希望如此。
cues.en: I hope so.

cues.zh: 有很多中国科技公司只会生产廉价仿制品。
cues.en: There are plenty of Chinese tech companies that produce nothing but cheap knockoffs.

cues.zh: DJI不在其中。
cues.en: DJI is not one of them.

cues.zh: 这家公司由一名叫Frank Wang的大学生于2006年创立。
cues.en: The company was started in 2006 by a college student named Frank Wang.

cues.zh: 他为无人机爱好者制作组件，然后决定打造一个完整的无人机帝国。
cues.en: He made components for drone hobbyists, and then decided to go ahead and make a full on drone empire.

cues.zh: 我认为DJI的核心价值是，我们总是试图创新出新的东西。
cues.en: I think the core value of DJI is, we're always trying to innovate something new.

cues.zh: 比如我们创造无人机时，实际上并没有飞行相机。我们创造了飞行相机这个概念。
cues.en: For example when we created drone, there are actually no flying camera. We created this concept of flying camera.

cues.zh: 这基本上是真的。
cues.en: That's basically true.

cues.zh: DJI的第一个巨大成功，Phantom，在2012年首次将相机无人机带给了大众。
cues.en: DJI's first runaway hit, the Phantom, brought camera drones to the masses for the first time in 2012.

cues.zh: 从那以后，他们制造了更大的无人机、更小的无人机、超小型的无人机，
cues.en: Since then they've made bigger drones, smaller drones, teeny tiny drones,

cues.zh: 以及一些专用型号，比如这台喷洒农药的无人机。
cues.en: and some specialty ones, like this crop dusting drone.

cues.zh: 他们的产品全都卖得很好。大多数主要竞争对手都灰溜溜地离开了。
cues.en: All its products have sold well. Most of its major competitors have flown away in tears.

cues.zh: 这家公司每年赚进数十亿美元，在全球各地有数千名员工。
cues.en: The company rakes in billions of dollars a year and has thousands of employees all over the world.

cues.zh: 现在，他们想把这份成功回馈出去。
cues.en: And now, they want to pay it forward.

cues.zh: 我们的创始人，在 DJI 稍微取得一些成功之后——
cues.en: Our founder, after DJI become a little bit successful -

cues.zh: 对，稍微有一点。
cues.en: Yeah a little bit.

cues.zh: 对。他开始觉得，是时候举办自己的机器人竞赛了。
cues.en: Yeah. He started to think that it's time to host his own robotics competition.

cues.zh: 我们希望工程师能成为明星，受到大家的认可。
cues.en: We want engineers to be recognized as superstars.

cues.zh: 我们希望这场竞赛能大受欢迎，让大家受到这些工程师的启发。
cues.en: And this competition, we hope it become very popular, and the people end up being inspired by these engineers.

cues.zh: 这不只有竞赛本身。还有 RoboMasters 纪录片、真人秀，甚至还有 RoboMasters 动画片。
cues.en: It's not just the competition itself. There's also a RoboMasters documentary, a RoboMasters reality show, and even a RoboMasters anime.

cues.zh: 通过这一连串的媒体宣传，DJI 希望培养新一代富有创新精神的工程师，
cues.en: With this media blitz, DJI hopes to foster a new generation of innovative engineers

cues.zh: 他们之后可以加入这家无人机帝国，让它更加强大。也可能创办下一家 DJI。
cues.en: who can then join the drone empire and make it even stronger. Or maybe start the next DJI.

cues.zh: 换句话说，这儿与其说是场友好的小机器人嘉年华，不如说是征服世界的计划。
cues.en: In other words, what we have here is less of a friendly little robot fest and more of a plan for world domination.

cues.zh: 看来只能由我来破坏这玩意儿了。
cues.en: Looks like it's up to me to sabotage this thing.

cues.zh: 这样看起来是不是更吓人？
cues.en: Does that make me seem scarier?

cues.zh: 嗯，有一点。
cues.en: Mm, a little bit.

cues.zh: 我成功潜入了这支浙江大学的队伍。
cues.en: I've managed to infiltrate this team from Zhejiang university.

cues.zh: 这简直太容易了。
cues.en: This is almost too easy.

cues.zh: 我们要和华盛顿大学对战。
cues.en: We're going up against the University of Washington.

cues.zh: 中国队通常会把美国队打得落花流水，不过有我拖后腿，双方应该势均力敌。
cues.en: Chinese teams usually destroy American ones, but my incompetence should even up the odds.

cues.zh: 你们别打我，好吗？我是第一名。我是第一名。
cues.en: You guys, don't shoot me, OK? I'm number one. I'm number one.

cues.zh: 我是第四名。
cues.en: I'm number four.

cues.zh: 哦，是啊。
cues.en: Oh yeah.

cues.zh: 准备好你们的队伍。
cues.en: Prepare your teams.

cues.zh: 机器人屠杀，现在开始！
cues.en: Let the robo-slaughter begin!

cues.zh: 那我该做什么？游戏开始后我要去哪儿？
cues.en: And what do I gotta try to do? Where am I going after the game starts?

cues.zh: 我现在得出去。
cues.en: I need to go out now.

cues.zh: 别丢下我！
cues.en: Don't leave me!

cues.zh: 我们是红队还是蓝队？
cues.en: Are we red or blue?

cues.zh: 我们赢了吗？怎么没人说话？
cues.en: Are we winning? How come nobody's talking?

cues.zh: 我真看不太出来发生了什么，比分接近吗？
cues.en: I couldn't really tell what was happening, was it close?

cues.zh: 所以我们把你们打得落花流水。
cues.en: So we kicked your ass.

cues.zh: 是啊，你们把我们打爆了。
cues.en: Yeah, you guys smashed us.

cues.zh: 好，谢谢。能和你们同场比赛是我的荣幸。真开心，谢谢。
cues.en: OK. Thank you. It was an honor to play with you guys. That was fun. Thank you.

cues.zh: 对不起，美国。我尽力了。
cues.en: I'm sorry America. I tried.

cues.zh: 几天后，我回到体育场，观看最后一轮比赛。
cues.en: A few days later I return to the stadium to witness the final round of competition.

cues.zh: 对阵双方是华南理工大学和东北大学。
cues.en: It's South China University of Technology versus China's Northeastern University.

cues.zh: 获胜者将带走数万美元，赢得其他极客的尊敬，
cues.en: The winners will take home tens of thousands of dollars, the respect of their fellow nerds,

cues.zh: 而且很可能拿到大疆或其他新兴公司的工作机会。
cues.en: and most likely a job offer from DJI or another up and coming company.

cues.zh: 女士们，先生们，请看，这就是中国未来的无人机制造者。
cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you, the future drone makers of the PRC.

cues.zh: 深圳已成为全球科技领域最重要的地方之一，这一点毋庸置疑。
cues.en: There's no disputing that Shenzhen has become one of the most important places in the world of tech.

cues.zh: 没有别的地方能把技术实力、低廉的制造成本和惊人的速度如此有力地结合起来。
cues.en: Nowhere else has quite as potent a combination of tech know-how, cheap manufacturing costs, and sheer speed.

cues.zh: 但事情还不止于此。住在深圳，很多方面就像生活在未来。
cues.en: But it goes further than that. Living in Shenzhen is in many ways like living in the future.

cues.zh: 而且未必是乌托邦式的未来，更像是另一种未来。
cues.en: And not necessarily a utopian future. More like the other kind.

cues.zh: 看看 Zowee。
cues.en: Consider Zowee.

cues.zh: Zowee 在深圳经营着一家和其他工厂差不多的工厂。
cues.en: Zowee operates a factory much like any other in Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 他们生产廉价智能手机和其他电子产品。
cues.en: They make cheap smartphones and other electronics.

cues.zh: 和其他大厂一样，他们建起了一片园区，工人可以住在生产线上班的地方旁边，
cues.en: Like other top manufacturers, they've built a complex where workers can live right beside the factory line,

cues.zh: 连续工作几年，希望能让家乡的家人过上更好的生活。
cues.en: work around the clock for a couple of years, and hopefully buy a better life for their families back home.

cues.zh: 这里的工厂很整洁，工作也很精细。
cues.en: The factories here are clean, and the work is precise.

cues.zh: 但一切正迅速变化，而这种变化对普通男女工人并不利。
cues.en: But things are changing quickly in a way that does not favor the common man and woman.

cues.zh: 其余这些产线大约有80名员工。
cues.en: All the rest of these lines are staffed by about 80 people.

cues.zh: 但这里正在上线的新机器，将从头到尾完全由机器人组装一部智能手机。
cues.en: But right here there's new machines coming online that are going to build a smartphone, end to end, completely by robots.

cues.zh: 这类事情最终目标是提升产品质量，
cues.en: The end goal of something like this is to get the quality of the products higher,

cues.zh: 通过减少人力来降低成本，并最终让中国保持世界制造中心的地位，
cues.en: to bring costs down for less labor and ultimately to keep China as the manufacturing hub of the world

cues.zh: 抵御来自东南亚等地的低价竞争。
cues.en: and fend off low-priced competition for places like Southeast Asia.

cues.zh: 未来的工厂就是这样。它是一个封闭的循环，机器人在彼此之间传递组件，
cues.en: The factory of the future looks like this. It's a closed-off loop where robots pass components among each other,

cues.zh: 成品在末端产出。
cues.en: and finished products pop out at the end.

cues.zh: 所有那些工人都被一个孤单的最终检验员取代了。
cues.en: All those workers have been replaced by one lonely final inspector.

cues.zh: 这是一个强烈的信号：深圳的未来，留给这些人的空间更少了……
cues.en: It's a strong sign that the future of Shenzhen is less for these guys...

cues.zh: ……还有更多供这些人使用的东西。
cues.en: ...and more for these guys.

cues.zh: Zowee 实际上会自己制造这些自动化设备。
cues.en: Zowee actually builds these automation machines itself.

cues.zh: 我身后是中国最优秀的一批工程师，他们正在努力制造你们今天在车间里看到的设备，
cues.en: Behind me are some of China's best and brightest engineers, hard at work building the machines you see out on the floor today,

cues.zh: 还有即将到来的设备，它们将实现整条工厂生产线的自动化。
cues.en: and the ones that are coming tomorrow that are going to automate the entire factory line.

cues.zh: 随着机器人崛起，把数百万工人推上失业队伍，深圳将面临最剧烈的动荡。
cues.en: Nowhere will face more turmoil than Shenzhen as the robots rise and send millions of workers to the unemployment line.

cues.zh: 但面临暗淡未来的，不只是工人阶级。
cues.en: But it's not just the working class that's facing a dark future.

cues.zh: 这里有些反乌托邦式的创新，似乎渗透到了生活的方方面面。
cues.en: There are dystopian innovations that seem to touch every facet of life here.

cues.zh: 我试着补充水分时，就遇到了一个这样的例子。
cues.en: I ran into one example of this while attempting to rehydrate.

cues.zh: 这个我能用吗？不能？好吧。
cues.en: Can I use this? No? OK.

cues.zh: 不，这个，不行。
cues.en: No, this, no.

cues.zh: 不管用？
cues.en: Doesn't work?

cues.zh: 调查一番后，我发现了这里的门道，关键就在这些东西上：二维码。
cues.en: After some investigation I discover what's going on here, and it has to do with these things: QR codes.

cues.zh: 你知道的，扫一下码，手机上就会弹出促销或折扣信息。
cues.en: You know the drill. You scan the code, and something pops up on your phone, like a promotion or discount.

cues.zh: 美国人多年前就对这类东西一笑置之，但在中国，它们撑起了整个经济。
cues.en: America laughed these things off years ago, but here, they run the entire economy.

cues.zh: 现金和信用卡已成历史。现在，买东西全靠扫二维码支付：
cues.en: Cash and credit cards are history. Instead, you scan QR codes to pay for everything:

cues.zh: 餐馆、超市，甚至街头艺人。
cues.en: restaurants, groceries, even buskers.

cues.zh: 表面上，这一切都很好。这是未来便捷的移动支付系统。
cues.en: On the surface, this is all good. It's the easy, convenient mobile payment system of the future.

cues.zh: 但背后也有阴暗面。
cues.en: But there's also a dark side.

cues.zh: 中国政府可以随意窥探支付宝和微信这两大主流支付系统。
cues.en: The Chinese government can peer into the two dominant payment systems, AliPay and WeChat, as it sees fit.

cues.zh: 它已经开始追踪行为，作为公民评分计划的一部分，
cues.en: It's already started tracking behavior as part of a plan to rank citizens

cues.zh: 衡量人们有多善良、多听话。
cues.en: and measure how good and obedient they are.

cues.zh: 科技革命也许给深圳带来了繁荣，
cues.en: The tech revolution may have brought prosperity to Shenzhen,

cues.zh:
但也给人们的生活带来越来越多隐蔽的侵扰。
Sorry, I can't respond to this question.
cues.en: but it's also brought more and more insidious intrusions into people's lives.

cues.zh: 为了深入了解中国暗黑体制下的生活，我组建了一支非凡的外国人团队
cues.en: To dig deeper into life under the Chinese deep state, I've assembled a team of extraordinary foreigners

cues.zh: 他们在深圳的科技创业公司工作。
cues.en: who work at tech startups in Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 希望几杯啤酒能让他们敞开心扉，聊聊自己的"思想罪"。
cues.en: Hopefully a few beers will encourage them to open up about their thoughtcrimes.

cues.zh: 生活在一个管控严格的共产主义国家——这会困扰你吗，还是你无所谓？
cues.en: Living in a very tightly regulated Communist country - Does that bother you or you don't care?

cues.zh: 至少我来之前从澳大利亚得到的预设是这样的
cues.en: Like, the presumption at least that I got before I came from Australia

cues.zh: 就好像搬进了一个军事化国家，感觉一切都会非常紧张。
cues.en: is sort of like moving into sort of like a militarized state kind of thing, like things are gonna be really intense.

cues.zh: 但实际你拿瓶啤酒，沿路走走，在公园里闲逛，都没问题。
cues.en: But like you take a beer, just like walk down the road, hang out in the park, fine.

cues.zh: 在我澳大利亚的家乡这么做，直接就被抓进局子了。
cues.en: Do that back in my hometown in Australia, straight to the cophouse.

cues.zh: 但然后呢，在草地上玩扣球游戏，警察突然就来制止你。
cues.en: But then, play spikeball on the grass, and then all of a sudden the cops come and stop you.

cues.zh: 你乱穿马路，被面部识别抓到了。
cues.en: Well and you got - you jaywalked and you had facial recognition

cues.zh: 最疯狂的是，我真收到了罚单。
cues.en: The craziest thing, I actually got this.

cues.zh: 对，我在南县乱穿马路，突然微信就收到了罚款通知。
cues.en: Yeah. So I was jaywalking in Nanxian, and all of a sudden I got a fine to my WeChat.

cues.zh: 是即时的吗？
cues.en: Was it instant?

cues.zh: 大概二十秒后吧。
cues.en: It was about twenty seconds after.

cues.zh: 我余额里有钱，直接就被扣走了。
cues.en: I had money in my balance and it just went straight out.

cues.zh: 什么！
cues.en: What!

cues.zh: 直接就被扣了。
cues.en: It just came straight out.

cues.zh: 都没授权过。太离谱了。
cues.en: Didn't even authorize it. That's crazy.

cues.zh: 是真的。在深圳某些地方试试乱穿马路，
cues.en: It's true. Try to jaywalk in certain parts of Shenzhen,

cues.zh: 政府的 facial recognition 就会认出你。
cues.en: and the government's facial recognition will spot you.

cues.zh: 甚至还有一块“羞耻榜”，展示近期违规者的脸。
cues.en: There's even a Board of Shame showing the faces of recent offenders.

cues.zh: 我很惊讶，也非常非常担心，他们的面部识别系统里有你的脸——
cues.en: I'm surprised and very very worried that they have your face in the face recognition system-

cues.zh: 但每个人的脸都有啊，过境的时候就会拍那张照片。对，没错。
cues.en: They have everyone's though, I mean when you go across the border they take that picture. Yeah exactly.

cues.zh: 是的，这些都在系统里。他们知道你在哪儿。
cues.en: Yeah, so it's all in the system. They know where you are.

cues.zh: 太可怕了。
cues.en: That's scary.

cues.zh: 更可怕的是，老大哥还在监视你上网的一举一动。
cues.en: It gets even scarier, because Big Brother is watching what you do online, too.

cues.zh: 我们熟悉和喜爱的大多数网站在中国都被屏蔽了，
cues.en: Most of the websites we know and love are blocked in China,

cues.zh: 换成了政府可以监控的中国同类网站：一个镜像宇宙般的互联网。
cues.en: replaced with Chinese equivalents that the government can monitor: a sort of mirror universe internet.

cues.zh: 我请了我的朋友Diane帮忙解释一下，她是深圳本地人。
cues.en: I asked my friend Diane, a Shenzhen native, to help break this down.

cues.zh: 挺应景的，她带我去了这家全是机器人服务员的餐厅。
cues.en: Appropriately enough, she took me to this restaurant staffed entirely by robots.

cues.zh: 那鸡肉看着有点吓人——那是鸡肉吗？
cues.en: That's some gnarly-looking chicken - is that chicken?

cues.zh: 嗯……机器人做的饭。
cues.en: Mmm... robot food.

cues.zh: 我想让你帮我个忙。如果我报一家美国科技公司，你能告诉我对应的中国版吗？
cues.en: I wanted you to help me out with one thing. So if I sort of call out a U.S. tech company, can you tell me the Chinese equivalent?

cues.zh: 因为这儿上不了Instagram什么的，所以。
cues.en: Because you can't get Instagram or anything here, so.

cues.zh: 我们来做几个类比。
cues.en: So let's do a few.

cues.zh: 那谷歌就相当于——
cues.en: So, Google would be -

cues.zh: 百度，对。
cues.en: Baidu, right.

cues.zh: 那亚马逊——
cues.en: And Amazon -

cues.zh: 就像京东，还有淘宝。
cues.en: is like, both JD.com and also Taobao.

cues.zh: 好，那YouTube呢？
cues.en: OK, and YouTube?

cues.zh: 啊，优酷。优酷、爱奇艺。
cues.en: Ah, Youku. Youku, Iqiyi.

cues.zh: Facebook呢？
cues.en: Facebook?

cues.zh: Facebook，我们有微信。
cues.en: Facebook, we have WeChat.

cues.zh: 微信。
cues.en: WeChat.

cues.zh: 是啊。你是不是觉得自己身处另一个世界？
cues.en: Yeah. Do you feel like you're in a different universe?

cues.zh: 所有线上的东西都是我们生活中很大的一部分，而中国似乎创造了自己的一个世界。
cues.en: All the online stuff is such a big part of our lives, and it seems like China has created its own world.

cues.zh: 是的，确实是这样。
cues.en: Yeah, that's definitely like that.

cues.zh: 但就像我说的，比如Instagram，我很惊讶地发现，连——
cues.en: But like I said, for like Instagram, I was surprised to see even -

cues.zh: Instagram在中国被封了，但所有年轻人，他们都在上面。
cues.en: Instagram got banned from China but all the young people, they're there.

cues.zh: 还是会用。对。
cues.en: Still go. Yeah.

cues.zh: 原来在这里确实可以访问那个崇尚自由的互联网，
cues.en: It turns out it is possible to access the freedom-loving internet here,

cues.zh: 通过所谓的VPN：一种绕过政府封锁的替代网络连接。
cues.en: via what's called a VPN: an alternate internet connection that bypasses the government's blocks.

cues.zh: 如果他们看到你一直挂着VPN，你不会惹上麻烦吗？
cues.en: And you don't get in trouble if they see that you're on the VPN all the time?

cues.zh: 就个人使用而言，我觉得这没什么大不了的。
cues.en: For personal use, I don't think that's like, a big deal.

cues.zh: 不同的世界将来会如何合作共事，这会很有意思。
cues.en: The future will be interesting for how the different worlds are like collaborating together.

cues.zh: 是啊，尤其是年轻一代，他们……
cues.en: Yeah, and definitely the young generation, they're...

cues.zh: 他们不会觉得待在圈子里就满足了。对，他们更有好奇心。
cues.en: They're not like just, oh, I'm satisfied just to kind of stay inside. Yeah, they're more curious.

cues.zh: 他们来到深圳，希望找到某种确凿的答案，
cues.en: The came to Shenzhen hoping to find some kind of ground truth,

cues.zh: 看清中国日益强大的科技实力将对我们其他人意味着什么。
cues.en: a clear picture of what China's growing tech prowess will mean for the rest of us.

cues.zh: 不过说实话，我还是一头雾水。
cues.en: Honestly though I'm as confused as ever.

cues.zh: 这座城市充满活力、雄心和创造力。
cues.en: This city is full of energy, desire, and creativity.

cues.zh: 但未来几年，这些特质究竟会如何发挥作用，仍然是个未知数。
cues.en: But exactly how those traits are channeled in the years ahead remains an open question.

cues.zh: 我希望人性中美好的部分能有机会蓬勃发展，
cues.en: My hope is that the best parts of our human nature get a chance to thrive,

cues.zh: 也希望《1984》再过几十年才会成为现实。
cues.en: and that 1984 can wait a few more decades to arrive.

cues.zh: 说到这里，我就用这只仪表盘小狗来结束，
cues.en: And on that note, I leave you with this dashboard dog,
